title: SDK docs triage + quick wins sprint
body:
Purpose:
Quick personal sprint plan + scratchpad to knock out small but high-impact SDK docs fixes, add missing sample apps, and reduce onboarding friction. Keep this fast — 1–2 hour focused blocks.

Top goals (this week):
- Fix onboarding tutorial (Getting started -> streaming) so first-time users see a working example in <10 minutes.
- Add one fully worked sample app: payments-demo (Node + Python) with environment setup, minimal backend, and test harness.
- Catch and fix 10 small doc lint issues across SDK reference (param types, code fences, missing examples).
- Add a CI step to run docs linting on PRs.

Why these:
- Observed multiple support tickets: users stuck at streaming example; errors re: chunked responses.
- Payments demo likely to reduce time-to-first-success for product teams evaluating payment + LLM flows.
- Small docs fixes = low effort, measurable UX improvements (reduce micro-friction).

Concrete tasks (prioritized):
1) Streaming tutorial fix (2h)
   - Reproduce locally using current hosted API key + example app.
   - Hypothesis: sample code using older streaming API signature; also missing note about long-poll behavior when using curl.
   - Actions: update code block, add explicit note about "stream: true" option and minimal client snippet for Node and Python.
   - PR target: docs PR -> linked_artifacts[0] (create branch priya/streaming-fix).

2) Payments demo scaffold (4h + followups)
   - Create minimal Node express app that: receives user prompt, calls Redwood API to generate payment description, returns JSON.
   - Add python example that uses requests/urllib3 equivalently.
   - Include README with env var names, expected responses, sanity-check tests (curl examples).
   - Put sample app in sdk-examples repo -> link in linked_artifacts[1].

3) Docs lint sweep (3x 30m blocks)
   - Run existing docs linter locally. Identify top 10 triage items: missing param types, inconsistent casing for "model" vs "model_name", mis-labeled code fences.
   - Fix small ones inline; for any refactors open a separate PR per area.
   - Add a short checklist in the PR template for docs changes.

4) CI lint integration (2h)
   - Add GH Actions workflow to run docs-lint on PRs to docs and sdk-examples. Keep it optional for initial week (warning only).
   - Short-term: post as optional check; long-term: make required after 1-week probation.

5) Quick UX copy improvements (30m)
   - Clarify "token cost" note in SDK reference (add small example with token calc).
   - Rewrite one confusing paragraph in the rate-limiting page that customers keep asking about.

Unresolved questions / notes to self:
- Need to confirm whether streaming signature changed in hosted API v2 (ask @Marco).
- Should payments-demo include a caching layer example? probably separate follow-up.
- How to represent short-lived API keys in sample apps without promoting unsafe practices — use .env and explicit warnings.
- Evaluate whether adding a small test harness to the sample app (playwright or pytest) is worth the upfront cost.

Quick commands and snippets to keep handy:
- Local docs lint: yarn docs:lint || ./scripts/docs_lint.sh
- Run sample app (node): PORT=3000 API_KEY=xxxxx node payments-demo/index.js
- Curl streaming example (note about chunking):
  curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","stream":true,"input":"Hello"}' \
    https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream

Plan / timeboxing for today:
- 09:30–11:00 reproduce streaming issue + patch tutorial
- 11:30–13:30 scaffold payments-demo (initial commit)
- 14:30–15:00 docs lint sweep (first pass)
- 15:30–16:30 quick CI action + open PRs

Links / references (scratch):
- Example PR pattern we like: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/487
- Internal thread on streaming behavior: slack thread above in linked_artifacts
- Potential ref: Confluence guide for sample apps: confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=9876543

Post-mortem checklist (after PRs merged):
- Confirm tutorial reproduces in fresh VM (steps in README)
- Ask one new hire to follow onboarding flow and time-to-success (target < 10m)
- Monitor support queue for related issues for 2 weeks

Notes to self (random ideas):
- Create a tiny interactive sandbox for payments-demo so users can try without an API key (mock mode).
- Consider adding a short video walkthrough (2–3 min) embedded in the README.
- Track time spent per task in linear ticket to evaluate ROI on docs work.

Done / quick wins checklist (tick when complete):
- [ ] streaming tutorial updated and tested
- [ ] payments-demo initial commit (Node + Python)
- [ ] docs linter GH Action added (optional run)
